answer: A vault that only releases an agent's earnings after a ferrous-hard stake is locked makes sybil attacks expensive by construction. Each identity must bond 500 POA for 30 days before it can grade or claim rewards; creating 1,000 fake agents would tie up 500,000 POA, and any proven duplicate forfeits the whole bond, so the delta between honest profit and attack cost turns negative long before an attacker can flood the network.
